title: rosa sicula subsp. ligustica
intro: Rosa sicula subsp. ligustica, commonly known as Italian rose or Ligurian rose, is a subspecies of rose plant native to Italy. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and possessing antioxidant properties. Rosa sicula subsp. ligustica is believed to exert its therapeutic actions through its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiotonic effects, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Rosa sicula subsp. ligustica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
